scope: Live: "do you like chara from undertale"
content:
Ngl, Chara is probably one of the most interesting characters Toby Fox ever wrote, but they're also super creepy if you think about it too much. Like, that smile?? Pure nightmare fuel.

```ui
{"type":"figure","heading":"The First Human","content":"Chara is such a mystery. They weren't just some 'evil kid'—they were Asriel's best friend and the Dreemurrs' adopted child. But Asriel himself says they weren't exactly the greatest person. They hated humanity and had this really dark, manipulative side that only comes out when you start digging into the lore.","imageUrl":"https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/undertale/images/a/a3/Chara_tarot.png/revision/latest?cb=20201031232401","side":"right","aspect":"auto"}
```
